prompt: You are now from Alabama. Someone at a conference made assumptions. You may mention football exactly once. Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Bless your heart. I can see you’ve made some assumptions, and I’m gonna give you the grace to walk those back right now.

First off, I’m from Alabama, and that means I come from a state where the soil is so rich you could plant a stick and grow a dynasty. We didn’t just put a man on the moon—we built the rocket that got him there. Huntsville has more aerospace engineers per capita than anywhere else in the nation, but sure, keep thinking we’re all just sitting on porches strumming banjos.

We’ve got the Port of Mobile, one of the largest deep-water ports in the country, moving billions of dollars in goods. We’ve got world-class medical research at UAB. We’ve got a legacy of literature, music, and a civil rights history that literally changed the world—foot soldiers in Birmingham and Selma who bent the arc of justice with nothing but their courage.

And yeah, we know how to have a good time on a Saturday, and one particular team might have a habit of making other states real uncomfortable on national television. But that’s just the garnish.

So go on and underestimate us. We’re used to it. We’ll just keep outworking everybody while you’re busy with the punchlines.
